name: From The Inside
source:
From The Inside is a romance visual novel revolving around the main character (you) who has lost his way in life, much like everyone, life can be very cruel and it is always nudging you off the path just when you are comfortable on the one you are taking. 

Throughout this novel you will make choices that determine which path your character will take. You will see him grow up, change and develop, and become his own individual self. With the help of your friends you may choose a path that is righteous or a path that is seen as reckless, but of course who is to judge you on what you do other than yourself? 

Through darkness things can become clearer, can’t they? But will the darkness consume you or will it invigorate you instead? 

[From [url=https://clarky014.itch.io/from-the-inside]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《From The Inside》是一部围绕在人生中迷失方向的主角（也就是你）展开的恋爱视觉小说。正如每个人都会经历的那样，生活有时极其残酷，总会在你刚刚适应脚下道路的时候将你推离正轨。

在这部作品中，你将做出一个个选择，决定角色所走的人生道路。你将见证他成长、蜕变，成为独一无二的自己。在朋友们的帮助下，你可以选择走上正道，也可以选择一条在外人看来鲁莽不羁的道路——不过话说回来，除了你自己之外，又有谁有资格评判你的所作所为呢？

穿过黑暗，事物反而会变得更加清晰，不是吗？只是这片黑暗究竟会吞噬你，还是会激发你的力量呢？

[引自[url=https://clarky014.itch.io/from-the-inside]Itch.io[/url]]
